public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.n04_referenceCurrent_transport_global_jet_bounds
public_declarations.header:
theorem n04_referenceCurrent_transport_global_jet_bounds
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hrefState : referenceStateConditions D S C)
    (hgeom : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (href : CanonicalGeometry.ReferenceJets D T S C L K)
    (hcur : CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base ε)
    (z : CanonicalGeometry.Parameter S) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
    (τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (q : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (hqual : WholeCanonicalTransportQualitative (D := D) C K
      (liftSectorParameter S C z) τ q) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧
      (∀ p ∈ annularOpen D, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n q p‖ ≤ B * T.M p.1) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ annularOpen D, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 2 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n τ p‖ ≤ B * T.M p.1)

public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.n04_referenceCurrent_transport_global_material_ratios
public_declarations.header:
theorem n04_referenceCurrent_transport_global_material_ratios
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hrefState : referenceStateConditions D S C)
    (hgeom : CanonicalGeometry D S C K base ε)
    (href : CanonicalGeometry.ReferenceJets D T S C L K)
    (hcur : CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L K base ε) :
    ∃ base' : ℕ, base ≤ base' ∧ ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base' η η,
        ∀ τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint,
          ContDiffOn ℝ 3 τ (annularOpen D) →
          MapsTo τ (annularOpen D) (annularOpen D) →
          (∀ m p, p ∈ referencePhysicalPieceOpen S K m →
            τ p = canonicalCurrentPoint C K (liftSectorParameter S C z) m p) →
          ∀ p ∈ annularOpen D,
            T.H (τ p).1 / T.H p.1 ≤ Real.exp 1 ∧
            T.M (τ p).1 / T.M p.1 ≤ Real.exp 1

mathematical_checks: The finite actual piece supplier fixes z then returns e before all pieces, points and q0..2/tau1..2 orders, retaining the exact T,K and sample T.sample(K.cell m).
The material ratio supplier returns r>=1 and M(sample)/M(p)<=r on the same reference physical piece. M(p)>0 is obtained from IsMaterialData's true 1<=M, not an E0 floor.

The complete product e*r is made subpower first, then one_power gives |e*r|<=B*M(sample) with B>0. Multiplying M(sample)<=r*M(p) by B and cancelling the strictly positive r proves e<=B*M(p), with no extra point-dependent exponent or sample replacement.

WholeCanonicalTransportQualitative has exactly the C3, map/period/reflection, actual per-piece field and q positivity clauses destructured here. Only its genuine global maps and local field identities are used; it supplies no desired numerical transport bound.

On an open reference piece, hfields gives actual global tau equal to canonicalCurrentPoint and actual q equal to Href/Hcurrent(tau). These point identities form actual neighborhood germs. The pinned iteratedFDeriv congruence transfers their genuine jets, including q order zero.

C3 of each given global map implies continuity of all normed jets through order2. The right hand B*M is continuous on the actual annular open set by the material smoothness clause. The exact reference-partition AE extension then passes all piece inequalities through root/cut complements.
The second public theorem selects the material window delta, then one base'/eta via n07a_inverseChart_material_displacement, before z, tau, m and p. It does not choose state-dependent neighborhoods.

For p in the reference piece, y=Fref(p) lies in the true canonicalOpen; the reference left inverse gives Gref(y)=p. The supplied actual piece identity gives Gcurrent(y)=tau(p). These exact equalities transform the existing displacement estimate into |tau(p).fst-p.fst|<=delta*ell(p.fst).

The window comparison is evaluated at the original physical point and its actual image. Both are in radialCore by referenceBounds and the given true MapsTo. It yields the correct Hforward and Mforward projections without comparing cell indices or asserting movingPhysicalPiece=referencePhysicalPiece.

Material ratio continuity follows independently from actual H/M smoothness, tau continuity, true MapsTo and denominator positivity. The same reference-partition theorem extends both <=exp(1) bounds to every annular point.

No E0>=1, final PrimitiveGeometry/transport certificate, unwrapped-angle zero-order bound, new witness or changed T/K/sample is introduced. Existing CurrentJets and ReferenceJets remain explicit inputs.
